title: The Last Lantern Anew
author: Isandro Galloway
blurb: Mirabel Vane, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
